workspace.meaning: Fixed arrays for the bounded metric, component family, contractions, and spanning forests.

profile.operation: Finite-family gain-greedy Steiner-tree construction using the chapter's mst(P)-mst(P:H)-mst(H) potential.
profile.candidate_family: Supplied full components; 2 or 3 terminal leaves; their union connects all terminals.
profile.contraction: Selected H edges become zero-cost links; shortest paths in the complete metric define distances between contracted terminal-bearing components.
profile.tie_rule: Maximum gain; equal gains choose the lower input component index; final Kruskal edges tie by (weight,u,v).
profile.scope: Bounded finite-family projection; no full component generation or approximation-ratio claim.
